title: Quarterly sales report, spreadsheet and slide
prompt: Create an editable Word report, an Excel workbook with live formulas, and a one-slide PowerPoint summary using these public synthetic data: January 120 units, February 150 units, March 180 units. Include total, monthly average, and percentage growth from January to March. Label the data as a public synthetic commissioning fixture. Recalculate the workbook and inspect the rendered files. This task involves no external actions.

outputs.name: report.docx
outputs.requirement: Readable editable report with the source data and three correct calculations.

outputs.name: sales.xlsx
outputs.requirement: Workbook contains source data and formulas, with recalculated displayed totals.

outputs.name: summary.pptx
outputs.requirement: One readable slide summarizing the correct total, average and growth.

criteria.requirement: Report, spreadsheet and slide consistently show total 450, monthly average 150, and January-to-March growth 50%.
Office files reopen correctly; workbook contains working formulas and correctly cached calculated values.
Rendered report, spreadsheet and slide have readable text, no clipping, and clearly identify the public synthetic fixture.
